steps.tx: **Rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis**, abbreviated as **RPGN**, denotes a clinical syndrome of rapid renal decline with more than **50%** loss of GFR within weeks, accompanied by active sediment and extensive **crescent formation** involving over 50% of glomeruli. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

steps.tx: **Pauci-immune** necrotizing **crescentic glomerulonephritis** accounts for **80%** of RPGN cases in older adults. Biopsy reveals segmental fibrinoid necrosis and cellular crescents without significant immunoglobulin or complement deposition on **immunofluorescence**. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring. Careful ongoing monitoring ensures optimal patient outcomes and prevents secondary complications.

steps.tx: Serological testing distinguishes vasculitic subsets. Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is predominantly linked to **c-ANCA** directed against **proteinase 3**, termed **PR3-ANCA**. In contrast, microscopic polyangiitis is associated with **p-ANCA** directed against **myeloperoxidase**, termed **MPO-ANCA**. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

left.title: PR3-ANCA / GPA
points: Clinical phenotype: Granulomatous airway lesions and cavitary nodules
Relapse profile: Significantly higher relapse rate

right.title: MPO-ANCA / MPA
points: Clinical phenotype: Severe pulmonary-renal syndrome without granulomas
Relapse profile: Lower relapse frequency but advanced fibrosis

steps.tx: The landmark **RAVE trial** demonstrated that **rituximab** dosed at **375** mg/m2 weekly for **4** weeks is non-inferior to daily oral **cyclophosphamide** for remission induction in severe **ANCA-associated vasculitis**, and superior in patients presenting with relapsing disease. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.
steps.say: The landmark RAVE trial demonstrated that rituximab dosed at 375 mg/m2 weekly for 4 weeks is non-inferior to daily oral cyclophosphamide for remission induction in severe ANCA-associated vasculitis, and superior in patients presenting with relapsing disease. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

rows: Superior in relapsing disease; avoids gonadal toxicity
Standard comparator; higher cumulative bladder cancer risk
Equivalent tapering schedule in both trial arms

steps.tx: The multinational **PEXIVAS trial** evaluated therapeutic **plasma exchange**, abbreviated as **PEX**, in severe ANCA vasculitis. Routine plasma exchange demonstrated no significant reduction in long-term **end-stage kidney disease** or all-cause mortality across the overall study cohort. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

steps.tx: **Avacopan**, an oral selective **C5a receptor** 1 antagonist evaluated in the **ADVOCATE trial**, proved non-inferior to standard glucocorticoid tapers for induction. It allowed complete elimination of high-dose systemic **corticosteroid** therapy, significantly reducing steroid-related adverse events. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

left.title: Avacopan Strategy
points: Glucocorticoid exposure: Completely eliminates high-dose oral steroids
eGFR trajectory: Sustained long-term renal function improvement
Toxicity profile: Significantly reduced infection and steroid morbidity

right.title: Standard Steroid Taper
points: Mechanism: Broad genomic and non-genomic glucocorticoid suppression
Glucocorticoid exposure: Prolonged high-dose oral prednisone taper
eGFR trajectory: Standard induction remission rate
Toxicity profile: High incidence of diabetes, cataracts, and osteopenia

steps.tx: The **Berden classification** stratifies renal biopsy prognosis in ANCA glomerulonephritis into four classes: **focal** with at least **50%** normal glomeruli conferring the best prognosis, **crescentic** with over 50% cellular crescents, mixed (intermediate prognosis), and **sclerotic** with over 50% global sclerosis conferring the poorest outcome. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.

steps.tx: Maintenance therapy prevents devastating clinical relapses. The **MAINRITSAN trial** proved that **rituximab** administered at **500** mg IV every **6** months for **2** years is markedly superior to daily oral **azathioprine** in sustaining remission in ANCA vasculitis. Thorough clinical assessment and laboratory correlation remain vital for accurate diagnosis and patient monitoring.
